thread:
maria_g: Heads-up — Q3 capacity planning note: Vendor A just updated lead times to ~16 weeks for A100-class GPUs. We have the EU pilot starting Sep 15 and current order schedules won't arrive in time unless we either accelerate orders or accept a reduced reserved pool. Need a quick decision on a buffer/stockpile policy. cc @kevin_w @oliver_h :eyes:
kevin_w: How urgent is this? Can we push the EU pilot window by 3 weeks instead of changing procurement strategy?
maria_g: We can shift the pilot, but customers (two financials + health) already confirmed Sept dates. Risk = losing momentum and revenue. Also we don't have spare budget to convert all burst to reserved.
oliver_h: What's the delta in cost if we increase reserved capacity vs relying on burst/spot? Need ballpark numbers.
maria_g: Quick calc below (back-of-envelope):
```
Current req: 40 A100s EU baseline
Reserved plan: 40 reserved @ $6k/month => 240k/month
Burst plan: 20 reserved + 30 burst (spot) avg => 20*6k + 30*1.8k = 120k + 54k = 174k/month
Stockpile (one-off buy window) estimate: 40 units upfront capex ~ $2.0M + 6-month ops = heavy
``` 
sophie_t: Also factor in vendor minimums and leadtime variability. If we front-load orders now we lock price but burn cash. Vendors offering 12-week shipping if we do a 30% deposit — might be a negotiation point.
raj_p: Budget team: We have up to $1.2M cushion this Q if leadership signs off, but that reduces runway covenants. Need exec OK.
kevin_w: Operationally, how fast can we provision EU racks once hardware lands? Infra SRE estimate?
oliver_h: Provisioning estimate: 2 weeks for racking, 1 week for validation, 1 week for model warmup => ~4 weeks from hardware-to-ready.
maria_g: Timeline if we order today (lead 16w + 4w provisioning) => 20 weeks => misses Sep 15.
kevin_w: Option A: negotiate lead time to 12 weeks via deposit + expedite fees (cost +5-8%). Option B: convert pilot to hybrid — run with reduced reserved capacity + cross-region warm failover from NA for first 6 weeks.
oliver_h: Hybrid increases latency risk for EU customers. Need SLA approval.
sophie_t: I can open negotiation thread with Vendor A and request 12-week lead time and a max expedite fee cap. Also check Vendor B availability for 8-week slots.
infra-bot: Reminder: Procurement approval form #PR-452 is missing finance sign-off. (automated)
maria_g: Proposed decision now: Approve up to $1.2M capex for a partial front-load of 20 A100s (half the EU baseline) + negotiate with Vendor A for 12wk for remaining 20. Set canary overflow to NA for first 6 weeks. This keeps pilot timeline with moderate cost/risk. :thinking_face:
kevin_w: +1 from platform side if raj_p confirms budget and Sophie gets vendor commit for <=12 weeks.
raj_p: I'll ping CFO; target to confirm by EOD tomorrow. If CFO says no, fallback = shift pilot 3 weeks and implement hybrid.
oliver_h: I'll draft the provisioning runbook for partial rack and cross-region overflow. Will include SLA mitigations and latency tracing hooks.
sophie_t: I'll start vendor talks and loop procurement. Will post updates in this thread. :phone:
maria_g: Action items: Sophie — vendor negotiation; Raj — CFO signoff; Oliver — runbook + SLA doc; Kevin — cost runway impact note; I'll prepare exec deck for the decision meet. Meeting proposal: tomorrow 09:30 PT. React with :thumbsup: if you can.
kevin_w: :thumbsup:
oliver_h: :thumbsup:
sophie_t: :thumbsup:
raj_p: :thumbsup: (unless CFO pushes back)
maria_g: Thanks — logging notes to roadmap tracker and tagging OKR infra.Q3.capacity. We'll reconvene after vendor update.
